title: Wall angels

steps.text: Stand with your back to a wall, with your head, shoulder blades and hips touching it.
steps.cue: Head, shoulder blades and hips on the wall.

steps.text: Hold your arms down by your sides with your palms facing out and the backs of your hands on the wall.
steps.cue: Arms down, palms out, hands on the wall.

steps.text: Slide your arms slowly out and up the wall as far as is comfortable. Keep the backs of your hands on it.
steps.cue: Slide your arms out and up slowly.

steps.text: Pause, then slide them slowly back down. Keep your lower back relaxed.

mistakes: Arching the lower back away from the wall.
Forcing the arms flat when the shoulders are not ready.
regression: Let your arms come a little away from the wall, and slide only a short way.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pinching or pain in your shoulders, or tingling in your arms.

anatomy.why: The upper back turns the shoulder blades as the arms slide, while the chest lengthens.
